figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Level 10 starts at Rs 56,100 basic pay in the 7th Pay Commission matrix. The Union Cabinet raised central DA from 60% to 63% of basic pay from 1 July 2026, a decision reported on 28 October 2026.

items.text: Watch out Fixed-amount clinical psychologist posts in the notices checked paid Rs 25,000 to Rs 50,000 a month, with no promise of a regular post.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: with Rs 5 lakh set aside for all studies, a tenth is Rs 50,000 and a fifth is Rs 1,00,000. The rest pays for books, supervised practice, travel to interviews and living costs in the gap between contracts.

items.text: The road runs from a master's, to a clinical course, to a notice that may not come this year.
